podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Before the Greenlight: Can AI Predict the Next Blockbuster with Ivan Zhurko
podcasts.description: If you’ve been hanging out with me since 2017, you know I’ve been tracking the collision of AI and the arts back when 'AI video' looked like a surrealist fever dream and 'AI voice' sounded like a polite but highly medicated robot. We watched static digital art evolve into generative universes, but today, we are talking about the real engine room of creativity: the business of making movies. The glamour of cinema is built on a mountain of logistics. Behind every beautiful cinematic shot is a spreadsheet, a schedule, and a producer pulling their hair out over scheduling conflicts, VFX budgets, and union rates. Today we discuss how platforms use AI to turn weeks of manual script-shredding, color-coded highlighting, and scheduling Tetris into a streamlined, minutes-long process. But this isn't just about saving time; it's about a deeper, philosophical shift. When AI handles the administrative friction of pre-production, does it free up filmmakers to take bigger creative risks—or does it fundamentally rewrite how a movie gets greenlit? Send us Fan Mail Many more amazing technology episodes to come! Subscribe and prepare for the new world. If you would like to join the show, please reach out.
